verdict.rationale: Trello documents a first-party MCP server that lets users 'Connect Trello to any AI tool', which gives AI-native users a path to operate Trello with natural-language prompts through an external AI client. Separately, its AI feature is only for writing and editing content, not for executing commands. The natural-language interpretation happens in the third-party AI tool, and the evidence is a single thin marketing line. Missing for 10: an in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
